set.body:
Purpose and scope
Define the next profile for phase1/phase2 with magnitude companions and explicit B0/IntendedFor declarations. Use the repository-pinned BIDS context and authoritative schema/spec to resolve pairing and echo-time rules; record exact versions and reviewed differences. Retain small licensed fixtures or explicitly labeled synthetic fixtures with checksums. Inspect sibling bids4s ownership/instructions before proposing portable resolver changes.

Acceptance proof
Fixture matrix covers a valid family, missing/ambiguous companions, incompatible entities or echo times, cross-session targets, missing references and overlap with existing phasediff/EPI coverage. Expected relationships and findings are independently authored, with provenance/license records. Explicitly exclude geometry/scanner qualification and phase-to-Hz computation.

Start here
modules/app/src/test/resources/mri-conformance; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app/MriConformanceSuite.scala; docs/bids4s-integration.md; sibling bids4s BidsFieldmaps boundary

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: F1: Specify and retain a bounded phase1/phase2 fieldmap corpus
